**Prior Degrees:** MSc, mechanical engineering, 2019

None

#### Project

*Detection of weld defect using deep learning method*

The project you will carry out focuses on applied analysis of electrical signals in welding using deep learning for the identification of weld discontinuities. The machine learning approach is based on the Convolution Neural Network (CNN) and deep learning techniques, which have attracted a lot of attention for automated identification of images and regression. We are working on applying the same technique on electrical signals obtained during the weld. Currently, industry relies on external technology such as weld imaging and non-destructive testing (NDT) to identify defects. These techniques are limited in their in-line ability to detect discontinuities inside a weld, and require an expert. Especially for critical welds this results in a slow process. The project aims to open the possibility of automated survey of an existing database of weld signals and builds on work currently carried out at the CCWJ. This project is setting the basis for a “big data” approach to research. You will have an opportunity to use your knowledge of engineering in practical applications of relevance to industry and society, and you will have firsthand access to our equipment to develop new knowledge during your academic exchange visit.
